items.title: The Mummy
items.description: A legend returns. This time - it won't stay buried. After the record-breaking resurrection of the horror franchise with the film 'Evil Dead Rise', screenwriter and director Lee Cronin turns to one of the most iconic horror stories of all time, bringing a bold and dark reinterpretation of The Mummy. The film centers on a family whose life is suddenly and completely overturned when their young daughter Katie, who mysteriously disappeared in the desert eight years ago, unexpectedly comes home, but will never be the same again. What should be a happy reunion soon turns into a living nightmare, and the family must uncover what happened to their daughter since she went missing.

items.title: The Devil Wears Prada 2
items.description: The sequel to the beloved film follows the chief editor of 'Runway' magazine, Miranda Priestly, as she navigates a world where print journalism is dying. Her former young assistant, Emily Charlton, is now an influential executive at a powerful advertising group, and money is desperately needed by Priestly.

items.title: Michael
items.description: "Michael" is a film portrait of the life and legacy of one of the most influential artists the world has ever known. The film showcases Michael Jackson's life outside of music, following his journey from discovering his extraordinary talent as the leader of the Jackson 5 to a visionary artist whose creative ambition sparked an unrelenting drive to become the world's greatest performer. Presenting his life off-stage, as well as some of the most legendary performances from the beginning of his solo career, the film gives audiences a chance to see Michael Jackson like never before - from the front row. This is where his story begins.

items.title: Mortal Kombat II
items.description: From New Line Cinema comes Mortal Kombat II, the latest installment of the legendary film franchise in all its brutal glory. Favorite champions, joined by Johnny Cage, enter the ultimate, uncompromising battle against the dark reign of Shao Kahn, which threatens the very survival of Earthrealm. Starring Karl Urban as Johnny Cage, the film is again directed by Simon McQuoid, based on a screenplay by Jeremy Slater, inspired by the video game by Ed Boon and John Tobias. With epic fight scenes, rich mythology, and respect for the original material, the film promises yet another big hit for fans of the franchise and action movie lovers.

items.title: Finny the Shark 2
items.description: In his second adventure on the big screen, the reckless Finny accidentally awakens the magic of an ancient staff and loses his ability to remain invisible! Now all Finny's friends are in danger. Before him lies a fascinating journey aimed at regaining invisibility and saving all Finny.

items.title: David
items.description: A spectacular musical adventure based on the biblical story, featuring voices of our excellent actors. From songs of a mother's heart to the quiet whisper of God's grace, David's story begins in humility and dedicated faith. When the giant Goliath rises and threatens his people, the young shepherd - armed only with a sling, some pebbles, and the courage given by faith - boldly stands to defend those he loves. On the journey that follows, the strength of loyalty, love, and perseverance is revealed, culminating in a great battle fought not only for a crown but for the good and future of the entire kingdom.

items.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
items.description: Based on the beloved children's literary series 'The Faraway Tree', the film 'The Magic Faraway Tree' follows Poli and Tim and their children Bet, Joe, and Fran, a modern family that moves to a remote English village. Soon upon arriving, without Wi-Fi or electricity to charge their precious electronic devices, the children are forced to develop an interest in nature. Exploring the surroundings of their new home, the children discover a magical tree and its unique and unusual inhabitants. At the top of the tree awaits a spectacular, fantastic world, and thus, the family, through the joys and challenges of new adventures, will learn to reconnect and appreciate each other for the first time in many years.

items.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Flight Before Christmas
items.description: Shaun the Sheep: The Flight Before Christmas is an entertaining family crime-mystery story that follows shepherd George Hardy (Hugh Jackman), who loves his sheep and reads them crime stories every night. What George does not know is that his sheep not only understand every complex twist but also debate clues for hours, led by witty sheep characters interpreted by Julia Louis-Dreyfus, Bryan Cranston, Patrick Stewart, Brett Goldstein, and Regina Hall. When their beloved George suffers an untimely death, the flock immediately realizes that this is not an accident, but a real case! As the local police officer has no idea what to do, the brave sheep conclude that they must leave the safety of their Irish pasture for the first time. Their mission is to use their collective intelligence to solve the case and protect their family.

items.title: Kill Bill: The Whole Bloody Affair
items.description: The film showcases a whole new version of Quentin Tarantino's epic revenge saga, uniting Volume 1 and Volume 2 into a single, uncensored cinematic experience. It includes a brand new, previously unseen anime sequence highlighting its spectacular scale. Uma Thurman shines as The Bride, who, after being left for dead following her wedding rehearsal is targeted for revenge. After waking from a coma, she embarks on a relentless quest to eliminate the remaining members of the deadly snake charmer squad before facing Bill. With iconic action sequences and unforgettable music, Kill Bill remains one of the most influential and iconic revenge sagas of modern cinema.

items.title: Kevin Can Wait
items.description: He didn't get married. But he got the best honeymoon of his life. After his fiancée leaves him at the altar in the middle of Italy, Met (Kevin James) unexpectedly embarks on his honeymoon—completely alone. What starts as the worst day of his life turns into a warm, funny, and heartwarming adventure through Italian culture, food, and the beauty of life. Along the way, Met rediscovers the joy of life and his own worth. His encounter with an Italian woman, Gia, changes his view on love while Italy opens up new doors for a fresh beginning.

items.title: The Super Mario Bros. Movie
items.description: THE SUPER MARIO BROS. MOVIE is an animated adventure inspired by the Super Mario Bros. universe and serves as a sequel to THE SUPER MARIO BROS. FILM, which premiered in 2023 and grossed over $1.3 billion worldwide. Both cinematic spectacles are produced by Chris Meledandri of Illumination and Shigeru Miyamoto of Nintendo. The film is a collaborative effort between Universal Pictures and Nintendo, with Universal Pictures as the global distributor. The direction of this exciting film is again credited to Aaron Horvath and Michael Jelenic, while Matthew Fogel is responsible for the screenplay. The music for the film is composed by Brian Tyler, who was also involved in the previous film.

items.title: Drama
items.description: A happy engaged couple faces temptation when an unexpected twist completely spirals out of control in the week leading up to their wedding.

items.title: Project Hail Mary
items.description: Available in 4DX and ScreenX format! Professor of Natural Sciences Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up on a spaceship, light-years away from home, with no memory of who he is or how he got there. As his memory gradually returns, he begins to uncover his mission: to solve the mystery of a mysterious substance causing the sun to slowly die. He must rely on his scientific knowledge and unconventional ideas to save everyone on Earth from extinction...but an unexpected friendship means that this task might not have to be done alone.

items.title: Harvest
items.description: Film "Žetva" prati zapanjujuću, istinitu priču o njemačkom barunu Johannu von Wagneru, koji nakon ilegalne transplantacije srca počinje imati uznemirujuće snove i vizije. Opterećen sjećanjima koja ne pripadaju njegovom životu i odgovornošću koju ne može ignorirati, Johann započinje osobnu i opasnu potragu za istinom. Njegovo putovanje vodi ga na Kosovo i Metohiju, gdje se suočava s mračnom stvarnošću ilegalne trgovine organima, povezanom sa zloglasnom "Žutom kućom". Susret s obitelji čovjeka čije srce nosi u grudima, njegovom majkom, suprugom i malim sinom Milanom, dodatno jača Johannovu želju da pokuša, čak i ako je prekasno, ispraviti nepravdu.

items.title: Sports Heart
items.source_title: Sportsko srce Ponosni na domaći film
items.description: Sportsko srce je topla komedija o sudaru dva nespojiva sveta kada mlada Maja odluči da spoji svog verenika, sofisticiranog Beograđanina Pavla, sa svojim ocem Macurom, harizmatičnim vlasnikom zemunske pečenjare. Dok Maja pokušava da "ugladi" oca za sudbonosni porodični ručak, a Pavle balansira između ljubavi i uticaja svoje dominantne majke, na površinu izbijaju generacijski jaz i duboko ukorenjene predrasude. Kroz niz komičnih nesporazuma, ova priča nas podseća da su iskrenost i prihvatanje jedini put ka zajedničkoj budućnosti, ma koliko različiti bili naši koreni.

items.title: Wedding
items.description: Poznati hrvatski privrednik na svoj rođendan saznaje da je pred bankrotom. U kancelariju mu ulazi porodica sa tortom i tamburašima, a u isto vreme zove ga ćerka koja studira u Londonu i uz čestitku mu saopšti da je trudna. Otac deteta je sin srpskog ministra spoljnih poslova. U stilu punokvrnog balkanskog anti-rom-coma, ispreplićući humor, toplinu i napetost, „Svadba“ prati priču o dve porodice čiji odnos stalno pleše između tople porodične priče i međunarodnog incidenta.

items.title: Iron Maiden: Burning Ambition
items.description: With unprecedented access to the band's official archives, IRON MAIDEN: BURNING AMBITION follows five decades of one of the most legendary musical journeys in history. Featuring interviews with the band members and collaborators such as Javier Bardem, Lars Ulrich, and Chuck D, this energetic film provides an intimate insight into their uncompromising vision and unbreakable connection with their global army of fans.

items.title: Summer Wars
items.description: The film is presented in Japanese with English subtitles. Kenji is a shy part-time moderator for OZ, a virtual world that powers everyday life, until the beautiful and popular Natsuki hires him to pose as her boyfriend. As he pretends to be a wealthy suitor in front of Natsuki's family, Kenji discovers that a rogue A.I. program has stolen his online identity, leading to his being accused of hacking OZ and causing disasters in the real world. As the destruction in OZ throws Natsuki's family into chaos, Kenji must unite his newfound connections to prevent an impending cyber apocalypse. From Academy Award-nominated director Mamoru Hosoda, rediscover Summer Wars on the big screen, now restored in stunning 4K resolution.

items.title: All You Need Is Kill
items.description: The film is presented in Japanese with English subtitles.

items.title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
items.source_title: The Girl Who Leapt Through Time
items.description: Film se prikazuje na japanskom jeziku s engleskim titlovima. Makoto je tipična tinejdžerka koja većinu dana provodi opuštajući se sa prijateljima. Jednog dana, dok žuri da se sretne sa svojom tetkom, skoro bude udarena od voza, ali u poslednjem trenutku skoči unazad kroz vreme, pre nesreće. Odmah počinje koristiti svoju novootkrivenu sposobnost da ispravi svaku sitnu neprijatnost – od loših rezultata na ispitima do nespretnih ispovesti ljubavi. Međutim, suočena sa posledicama igranja sa vremenom, Makoto mora učiniti sve što može kako bi izbegla strašnu budućnost koju se ne može vratiti. Od reditelja nominovanog za nagradu Oskar, Mamorua Hosode, ponovo otkrijte *The Girl Who Leapt Through Time* na velikom platnu, sada restauriran u zadivljujućoj 4K rezoluciji.
